categories.name: Focus & Thinking
categories.direct_answer: A useful focus routine combines realistic practice, supportive conditions, and clear limits rather than a single promised fix.

categories.name: Memory & Sleep
categories.direct_answer: Daily memory supports and sleep-aware routines can be evaluated as practical habits, not guarantees.

categories.name: Student Learning
categories.direct_answer: Study plans work best when they are manageable, repeated, and reviewed against real learning needs.

categories.name: Workplace Performance
categories.direct_answer: Attention management at work should address workload, environment, recovery, and realistic task systems.

categories.name: Healthy Aging
categories.direct_answer: Healthy-aging guidance emphasizes broad, sustainable habits and discussion with a clinician when appropriate.

categories.name: Digital & Memory Tools
categories.direct_answer: Evaluate tools by evidence, intended outcome, usability, cost, and limitations before paying.

categories.name: Books, Games & Courses
categories.direct_answer: Compare learning resources by their aims, evidence, practical fit, and claims rather than assuming broad cognitive effects.

categories.name: Evidence & Editorial Practice
categories.direct_answer: Evidence should be read in context of population, method, comparison, outcome, and stated limitations.

categories.name: Market & Program Evaluation
categories.direct_answer: Market and workplace-program decisions require a transparent framework, evidence review, and fit with the actual use case.
